records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_dictionary.FeatureHelpFilter.eventFilter#1
records.source: THE EVENT TYPE IS READ FIRST, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: “先读取事件类型”，然后才进行存活检查。此过滤器安装在 QApplication 上，因此以前两次 `_still_alive` 调用会针对进程中的每个事件运行——在一次打开 Regression 时就有 94,431 次，而一次性能分析在一次打开 Mask 时统计到这两个调用共 839,906 次。读取 C++ 部分已被销毁的对象的类型会抛出异常，而下方的 `except` 已经用同样的 `False` 处理了这种情况，因此调整顺序没有任何代价，现在只有上下文菜单才会运行这些检查。
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.review_basis: MT draft edited in AI review
